memory_update.text: AMKR should remain in the AI advanced-packaging universe as a US-listed OSAT with direct advanced packaging/test capacity exposure; verify materiality, margins, and customer commitments before upgrading.
FORM is a strong underfollowed HBM test/probe-card candidate; key survival tests are HBM revenue mix, customer breadth, margin profile, and durability into HBM4.
ONTO maps to the inspection/metrology subnode of AI advanced packaging and HBM expansion; verify backlog, HBM customer wins, and advanced packaging revenue materiality.
KLIC, TER, AEHR, COHU, ACLS, CAMT, and US-listed/ADR substrate or packaging-material names should be screened in a later pass, but evidence strength and AI revenue materiality vary.

The node is not only TSMC/ASML/HBM memory makers; second-order bottlenecks include OSAT capacity, HBM probe cards, inspection/metrology, thermocompression bonding, underfill/materials, ABF substrates, thermal interfaces, and test handlers.

node: Advanced packaging, HBM integration, leading-edge foundry, and semiconductor equipment
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the advanced packaging/HBM/foundry-capacity node with a two-lane structure: one reference anchor and three more direct underfollowed chokepoint suppliers. TSM is the obvious capacity anchor for leading-edge foundry and CoWoS-style packaging context. AMKR maps to outsourced advanced packaging/test capacity, FORM to HBM probe cards and semiconductor test intensity, ONTO to advanced packaging/HBM inspection and metrology. KLIC was a close alternate for thermocompression bonding, but was excluded to keep the list at four candidates.
